scope: Physical-quantity/units/interval contract for supplied regional comparisons. Synthetic known answers validate implementation; seven protected replays confirm no map changes. This is not new independent environmental validation.
known_answer_checks: P07 horizontal speed and selected signed radar rate use separate named series on their own common footprints.
GUNW checks measured-pair LOS displacement, not an annualized trend.
Dimension-preserving displacement/rate units retain original inputs and explicit conversion.
Invalid/missing quantities, wrong components, negative speed, ambiguous/mismatched intervals, duplicates and nonfinite references are rejected.
UTC date matching, explicit exclusions, legacy assumptions and escaped/bounded comparison UI are tested.
One compared record leaves bias-removed RMSE unavailable; unavailable matched summaries never become zero error.
Product-scoped help and option serialization omit irrelevant hidden numeric references for GCOV.
Scaled residual arithmetic preserves finite large errors and tiny nonzero errors rather than overflowing/underflowing RMS statistics.

errors: Reference units must describe the same physical quantity: displacement units for LOS pairs; rate units for radar rates or horizontal speed. No rate-to-displacement conversion is guessed.
Each regional reference must identify exactly one selected UTC acquisition interval. Check date and end.
Horizontal-mode references must state quantity and unit. Choose horizontal_speed, or radar_component_rate with its component; a signed radar component is not horizontal speed.
